policy.trigger: after all relaxations of each valid expansion
policy.ratio: physical heap size / distinct valid open states; zero valid states removes all remaining stale
policy.keep: entire original (f,secondary,serial,node,g) tuple if g == best_g[node]
policy.peak: actual physical heap peak immediately after each push, before any cleanup

timing.includes: full solver call: validation, normalization, heuristics, open maintenance, cleanup scanning, heapify, search, backtracking and result accounting
timing.excludes: oracle, trace collection, order/path verification, charts and file IO
timing.repeats: seeded random order across rho and original implementation in each batch
timing.references: same-kernel inf includes open bookkeeping; original astar is a separate same-batch reference
timing.error_bars: batch IQR, descriptive, not confidence intervals

interpretation: best in tested candidates/workload only; boundary minimum is not an internal optimum; do not force a U curve
